scripts.size: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const dirs=['client/src','engine/src','engine/test','server/src'];let files=0,lines=0;const walk=d=>{for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const f=p.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())walk(f);else if(/\.tsx?$/.test(e.name)){files++;lines+=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').split('\n').length}}};dirs.forEach(walk);console.log(files+' files, '+lines+' lines')"
